author: Stan64
what_it_is: All 40 skins, all 48 characters and all 52 puzzles unlocked.
format: PSP save folder, 4 files in the folder ULJS00005LUMINES/: PARAM.SFO (SAVEDATA_DIRECTORY ULJS00005LUMINES, TITLE LUMINES, SAVEDATA_FILE_LIST names no file (4 bytes 785f6908, then zeros)), DATA.BIN 18464 bytes (encrypted by the system's savedata call), ICON0.PNG, PIC1.PNG

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/psp-savedata.py memstick <zip> <memory stick>: writes the zip's files, unchanged, to PSP/SAVEDATA/<SAVEDATA_DIRECTORY>/ (the name read from PARAM.SFO)
